x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Since number correct, headline neutral and only report facts.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Even when number correct, word choice and omission fit change impression.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Number correct, but 'slaps' and omitting 'first in 12 years' give one-sided impression.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: This judgment check facts and evaluate tone/omission separately.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Number wrong, so headline false and bias no need discuss.

x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: E contain only confirmed facts (vote, amount), no judgment words.
